book.title: Crit Hit & Run
invariants: No convenient amnesia as a continuity device.

chapters.title: The One Percent Solution
chapters.goal: Introduce the protagonist to the System and reveal the broken 'Crit' multiplier during a fatal tutorial encounter.
chapters.stakes_shift: From certain death as a mundane human to survival as a glitched outlier with a lethal damage ceiling.

bridge.from_prev: Protagonist dies in the real world and awakens in the tutorial zone.
bridge.to_next: Armed with a broken mechanic, the protagonist seeks to maximize tutorial rewards before the zone closes.

chapters.title: Looting the Logic Gates
chapters.goal: Systematically dismantle tutorial challenges to acquire high-tier 'Starter' gear through overkill bonuses.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a lucky survivor to a heavily geared exploiter who is now ahead of the intended power curve.

bridge.from_prev: The protagonist realizes the System rewards 'overkill' damage with better loot drops.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist enters the first major hub city and attracts unwanted attention from the local guard.

chapters.title: The Glass Cannon's Gambit
chapters.goal: Survive an 'Impossible' ranked sub-quest by utilizing terrain exploits and the high-crit 'Run' strategy.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a low-level anomaly to a high-priority target for local power players who want his 'secret'.

bridge.from_prev: A local merchant lord offers a suicide mission that the protagonist accepts for the unique rewards.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist discovers that his crit mechanic is tied to a specific 'Bug' in the world's physics engine.

chapters.title: Bug Report Pending
chapters.goal: Investigate the source of the glitch while avoiding 'System Sentinels' designed to patch out irregularities.
chapters.stakes_shift: From exploiting the game for fun to a desperate race against a System-wide deletion protocol.

bridge.from_prev: The protagonist encounters the first 'Sentinel'—a faceless entity that ignores standard game rules.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist must form a temporary alliance with a disgraced former Admin character.

chapters.title: Aggro Management
chapters.goal: Defend a temporary safe-haven against a wave of bounty hunters and Sentinels using the 'Hit and Run' doctrine.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a solitary fugitive to the leader of a small 'Glitch' resistance, increasing the scale of conflict.

bridge.from_prev: The Admin reveals that the protagonist's crit is actually a 'Developer Tool' left in the live build.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist decides to strike the System's local data-hub to secure his existence.

chapters.title: The Infinite Multiplier
chapters.goal: Infiltrate the Regional Core and use the Crit exploit to defeat a Level 99 Guardian at Level 15.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a hunted anomaly to a world-altering force that the System can no longer ignore or easily delete.

bridge.from_prev: The resistance provides a distraction, allowing the protagonist to reach the Core's inner sanctum.
bridge.to_next: The Core is shattered, causing a localized reality collapse that the protagonist must escape.

chapters.title: Running for the Borderlands
chapters.goal: Escape the collapsing region and reach the 'Unmapped Zones' where System authority is weakest.
chapters.stakes_shift: From an active combatant to a strategic mastermind planning the long-term subversion of the world.

bridge.from_prev: The Regional Core's destruction creates a permanent 'Dead Zone' behind the protagonist.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist looks out over the Unmapped Zones, ready to start Book 2 with a new set of exploits.

sections.title: The Fatal Error
sections.intent: Establish the protagonist's mundane death and the jarring transition into the System tutorial.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist awakens in the white-room tutorial space and receives the first System prompt.

sections.title: Identifying the Glitch
sections.intent: Introduce the combat mechanics and the first realization that the Crit multiplier is behaving abnormally.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist successfully triggers a 100x crit on a training dummy, causing a physics error.

sections.title: The First Payday
sections.intent: Show the protagonist intentionally using the glitch to secure high-value loot from the first tutorial mob.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist loots a 'Legendary' starter dagger from a common tutorial rat due to overkill bonuses.

sections.title: The Overkill Protocol
sections.intent: The protagonist tests the limits of the 'Crit' multiplier to maximize loot drops across multiple encounters.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist confirms that damage exceeding 1000% of enemy HP guarantees a rarity tier jump.

sections.title: Boss Room Bypass
sections.intent: A high-intensity fight where the protagonist uses the glitch to one-shot the Tutorial Boss.
sections.end_condition: The Tutorial Boss is vaporized by a single strike, dropping a unique 'Glitched' item.

sections.title: Graduation Day
sections.intent: The protagonist prepares to leave the tutorial zone with an inventory full of unintended gear.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist steps through the tutorial exit portal into the main game world.

sections.title: High Stakes in the Hub
sections.intent: Introduce the local merchant lord and the 'Impossible' quest offer.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist signs the soul-bound contract for the quest 'The Heart of the Glitch'.

sections.title: The Glass Cannon's Journey
sections.intent: The protagonist travels to the quest zone, using 'Hit and Run' tactics to avoid standard level-gated mobs.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist arrives at the entrance of the Forbidden Archive.

sections.title: Exploiting the Terrain
sections.intent: A combat-heavy sequence where the protagonist uses environment glitches to survive high-level enemies.
sections.end_condition: The quest objective is secured after the protagonist crits a support pillar to collapse the room on the boss.

sections.title: Unwanted Fame
sections.intent: The protagonist escapes the zone just as the merchant's rivals arrive to investigate the damage.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist hides in the city slums, realizing he is now a person of interest.

sections.title: The Unseen Eye
sections.intent: Establish the presence of System Sentinels and the feeling of being hunted by the game itself.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist narrowly avoids a deletion beam from a cloaked Sentinel.

sections.title: Breadcrumbs of the Devs
sections.intent: The protagonist follows clues regarding the origin of the 'Crit' glitch.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist decrypts a message leading to the 'Null Sector' where the Admin is hiding.

sections.title: The Admin's Door
sections.intent: The protagonist navigates a non-Euclidean dungeon to reach the Admin's sanctuary.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist meets the disgraced Admin and learns the truth about the 'Developer Tool'.

sections.title: The Bounty is Set
sections.intent: The protagonist prepares the safe-haven for an inevitable assault by bounty hunters.
sections.end_condition: The first wave of bounty hunters arrives at the sanctuary gates.

sections.title: The Guerilla Defense
sections.intent: Showcase the 'Hit and Run' strategy as the protagonist picks off hunters one by one.
sections.end_condition: The bounty hunter leader is defeated with a 5000% overkill crit.

sections.title: The Patch Arrival
sections.intent: The System sends multiple Sentinels to 'cleanse' the area, forcing the protagonist to flee.
sections.end_condition: The sanctuary is destroyed as the protagonist and the Admin escape into the sewers.

sections.title: Infiltrating the Core
sections.intent: The protagonist sneaks into the Regional Core facility under the cover of a resistance distraction.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist bypasses the final security firewall of the Core.

sections.title: The Ascent of Errors
sections.intent: Navigating the interior of the Core where reality is already beginning to warp.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist reaches the central platform where the Level 99 Guardian awaits.

sections.title: Dividing by Zero
sections.intent: The final battle where the protagonist pushes the 'Crit' glitch to its absolute breaking point.
sections.end_condition: The Guardian is deleted from the server logs by an infinite damage loop.

sections.title: Structural Failure
sections.intent: The protagonist physically destroys the Core, initiating a regional shutdown.
sections.end_condition: The Regional Core explodes, sending a shockwave through the game world.

sections.title: The Falling Sky
sections.intent: The protagonist must navigate the rapidly collapsing environment of the region.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist reaches the edge of the 'Dead Zone' created by the Core's destruction.

sections.title: The Border Run
sections.intent: A desperate dash toward the Unmapped Zones while avoiding the last of the System's automated defenses.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist crosses the invisible boundary into the Unmapped Zones.

sections.title: Beyond the Map
sections.intent: Establish the new status quo and the protagonist's intent to keep exploiting the world.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist looks out over a chaotic, lawless landscape and begins planning Book 2.
